name: budget50_groq
_about: Cheaper than budget50: the planner, the gate, the worker, the draft and the editor use openai/gpt-oss-120b on Groq (strong reasoning at 0.15 in and 0.60 out per 1M tokens, tested end to end). Triage, tools, cleaning, the checker and the question use gemini-3.1-flash-lite. Needs GROQ_API_KEY and GROQ_URL. Untested as a combination.
